pipelines.name: Build Storybook Docs v2
findings: [MEDIUM] NO_CACHE: MEDIUM: Workflow installs dependencies without 'actions/cache' or setup action caching.
[HIGH] EXCESSIVE_PERMISSIONS: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
[LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'build-docs' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.

anti_patterns.message: MEDIUM: Workflow installs dependencies without 'actions/cache' or setup action caching.
anti_patterns.remediation: Enable built-in caching on setup-* actions (e.g., cache: 'pip' or 'npm') or add an explicit actions/cache step.

anti_patterns.message: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
anti_patterns.remediation: Declare explicit least-privilege 'permissions:' (for example, contents: read) at the workflow or job level.
Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).

pipelines.name: Approve and enable auto-merge for dependabot
findings: [HIGH] UNPINNED_ACTION: Job 'review' step 1 uses unpinned action 'dependabot/fetch-metadata@v1.6.0'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
[LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'review' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.

anti_patterns.message: Job 'review' step 1 uses unpinned action 'dependabot/fetch-metadata@v1.6.0'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).
Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).

pipelines.name: Mark stale issues and pull requests

with.stale-issue-message: This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity and needs more information. It will be closed if no further activity occurs.
with.stale-pr-message: This PR has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity and needs further changes. It will be closed if no further activity occurs.
with.close-issue-message: This issue has been closed due to inactivity and lack of information. If you still encounter this issue, please add the requested information and re-open.
with.close-pr-message: This PR has been closed due to inactivity and lack of changes. If you would like to still work on this PR, please address the review comments and re-open.

findings: [LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'stale' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.

anti_patterns.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).
